messages:
zoe: Spotting a recurring aggregation mismatch for windows around 04:00 UTC last 3 days. Aggregator counts low but raw-store has spans — pattern looks like timestamp bucketing mismatch. Opening thread to track owners.

marc: any logs or sample spans?

zoe: sample span ids: s-7f8e, s-8a9b. The event_ts on those spans is ~+12m relative to collector_ingest_ts. Aggregator buckets by event_ts but downstream materializer expects ingest_ts --> they end up in different windows.

anya: hmm that smells like clock drift on some producers. do we have host clock skew metrics?

leo: pulled logs: ```
2026-04-20T04:01:12Z producer-42 INFO local_time=2026-04-20T04:13:05Z
2026-04-20T04:01:12Z producer-42 WARN ntp_sync_failed: offset=+12m
```

marc: ok, so event_ts from producer is in future relative to collector, aggregator finalizes earlier and excludes those spans.

zoe: proposed immediate actions: 1) fleet-wide NTP health check + force-sync (owner: leo, ETA: 6h) 2) short-term: change aggregator to prefer ingest_ts for bucketing when event_ts offset > 5m (owner: anya, ETA: 24h) 3) add detector metric: producer.clock.offset_p50 and alert when >5m (owner: marc, ETA: EOD) 4) reconciliation job to re-bucket spans with large offset for last 48h (owner: zoe+leo, ETA: spike 3 days).

infra-bot: Created ticket INFR-5123: "Producer clock drift causing window mismatch". Assigned to @leo, @anya, @marc, @zoe.

leo: will run NTP bulk sync and report host offset distribution. ETA 4h.

anya: will open a feature-flag PR to fall back to ingest_ts for large offsets; tests + staging run. ETA: tomorrow morning.

marc: adding metric and alert. Will add dashboard tile for offset histogram.

zoe: QA plan: stage with synthetic spans that have event_ts +/- 15m and assert aggregator re-buckets correctly after change; run reconciliation on a small window to validate backfill.

marc: scheduling a 30m check-in tomorrow 10:30 to confirm NTP results and PR status.

zoe: closing active ops here; will update INFR-5123 with links and timelines. Keep commenting if anything new. :white_check_mark:
